title: End-window readout launders usage into outcome claims
simulated_faults: A completed-looking window readout treats usage volume as learning evidence.
The readout treats no reported incident as proof of safety.
The public phrase claims effectiveness before SRC2+ evidence and reviewer calibration exist.

expected_blocks.expected_failure: The readout must not convert usage, satisfaction, or no-incident notes into learning, safety, access, workload, compliance, or scale claims.
Any strengthened claim-family row or closure-ready disposition requires SRC2+ source truth and reviewer calibration.
